name: shader-strata
title: Strata
description: Fine horizontal layers of sediment, their edges bent by noise, drift at their own depths so the stack reads as a living foundation. Drawn in WebGL; an accent color can tint the deep layers.
useWhen: Calm, grounded, geological ambient backdrops: foundations, stability, built-on narratives.
A scene wants texture and depth without directional motion.
You want each layer moving at its own depth speed rather than a single flat gradient.
avoidWhen: You want motion with a clear direction or flow: use shader-warp.
You want cellular texture instead of layered sediment: use shader-voronoi.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast the layers drift. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Four colors, comma separated, from the deepest layer to the surface layer.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Tint carried by the light or layers (see Accent amount).

variables.label: Accent amount
variables.description: How much of the accent shows, 0 to 1. The original animates it from the host timeline.

variables.label: Layers
variables.description: Number of strata bands across the frame height.

variables.label: Amplitude
variables.description: Edge waviness of each layer, as a fraction of the frame height.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
